title: Waterfall
description: A running total step by step: per step a rise bar from the level the last step left, pointed at its top and in the rise token, then a fall bar dropping from the rise's top, pointed at its bottom and in the fall token; amounts above and below the bars, the next step starting where the fall ends. Muted steps draw out of bounds.

anatomy.description: The root with data-slot="waterfall", role="img", the per-step nets as its summary and data-focus.
A group per step translated to its band: the hit rect over the band, the pointed rise and fall paths, their amounts, and the label; data-muted and data-focused as the state says.

usage: rise and fall are both positive amounts; the chart computes the running level and the net itself.
The two tokens --juni-waterfall-rise and --juni-waterfall-fall are the chart's only colours (theming §5.6); a legend uses the same two.
The pointed ends carry direction, so never add arrows or signs to the amounts.
Keep hover in the caller: onHover reports the step's id or null; focus holds one step full while the others step back.
